org.name: Coventry and Warwickshire Partnership NHS Trust

hazard: Insufficient handover time for escorted leave
theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Katy Samuels
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

promises.quote: The Trust has identified that extending the time for staff to handover, from one shift to the next, will require a thorough review of the roster and supporting processes that the Trust operates to generate staff shift patterns. This work, ultimately leading to an increase in the protected time for handover from ten minutes will impact on current shift patterns. The Trust cannot change shift patterns without a robust consultative process and is, therefore, working with union and staff side representation
promises.summary: Extend protected handover time from ten minutes via roster review and union consultation

concerns.quote: The policy is targeted at inpatient and community staff
Leave should be planned in advance, agreed at the multidisciplinary team meeting and consideration must be given to the legal status of the patient
concerns.hazard: lack of clear guidance for escorted leave

concerns.quote: The circumstances of this inquest touching upon the death of Katy Samuels accentuated this point.
concerns.hazard: unverified escort identity and unknown departure time

concerns.quote: staff handovers are vital and therefore time to enable the same very important.
concerns.hazard: insufficient handover time for escorted leave

reports.title: Darren Hope: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Section 17 leave conditions may not always be thoroughly reviewed or clarified before a service user is signed out for leave
There may be a lack of accessible or reliable means for service users on unescorted leave to contact the facility if they encounter difficulties
There may be limitations in the reporting system's ability to identify and address substantive issues that directly impact patient safety

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that Section 17 leave conditions are not consistently verified or clarified before a patient is allowed leave. This gap in verification can compromise patient safety during unescorted leave.
links.earlier_quote: Leave should be planned in advance, agreed at the multidisciplinary team meeting and consideration must be given to the legal status of the patient.... Leave should only be granted after careful planning and risk assessment
links.later_quote: Section 17 leave conditions may not always be thoroughly reviewed or clarified before a service user is signed out for leave.
